title: Energy and Power Grid
seoDescription: imc measurement and monitoring for wind turbines, power plants and energy networks: power quality to EN 50160 and IEC 61400, load and grid integration measurements.

props.title: Energy and Power Grid
paragraphs: imc works with leading energy companies on turnkey measurement and monitoring solutions for wind turbines, power plants and energy networks. The robust systems work independently of a PC, with signal conditioning, AD conversion, real-time computation and data storage integrated.
They are modular and decentralised, can be synchronised over a network, by GPS or by direct cable, and are operated with imc STUDIO and imc WAVE.

items.title: Prototype and component tests
items.text: Measurements on prototypes and components, including development and certification of wind turbines.

items.title: Power curve measurement
items.text: Power curve measurements to optimise efficiency.

items.title: Load measurement
items.text: Load measurements that verify safety, stability and durability, plus load and electromechanical efficiency measurements.

items.title: Grid and supply quality
items.text: Power monitoring and quality analysis to EN 50160 and IEC 61400-7, -15, -21 and -30: frequency, voltage spikes, fluctuations, harmonics, flicker and signal frequencies.

items.title: Grid integration
items.text: Measurement of electrical quantities such as voltage, current and power, and of all output power and performance parameters.

items.title: Condition monitoring
items.text: Automatic condition monitoring, sound and noise measurement and measurement data transfer with imc LINK.
